name: qlrisk_price_floating_rate_note
title: Price a FloatingRateNote
description:
Price one Floating Rate Note (qlrisk FloatingRateNote).
Inputs (* required, name=default): maturity*, face_value=100, frequency=quarterly, index=SOFR, spread_bp=0, currency=USD. In `advanced` also: effective_date, issuer, position.
Example: {"maturity": "5Y", "face_value": 100} gives NPV 100.23 USD (sample market valued 2026-10-09).
